decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical machine instruction and processor flag constants.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
DOS MSDISP, MISC, MSINIT and other modules include mi.inc.
MISC uses mi_INT, mi_Long_CALL and mi_Long_RET; the previous 682-byte comparison found five address bytes and one version byte differing (review 079).
MSDISP uses f_Carry; its previous 570-byte comparison found twelve marked relocation bytes and one version byte differing (review 087).
limitations: Selected module comparisons support exercised constants only. Version definition, final addresses, other configurations and full core binary equality remain unverified.
